configuration.initialization: Uniform behavioral strategy; CFR zero regrets, fictitious play one uniform prior observation, double oracle one uniform seed strategy per player.
configuration.comparison: All main runs complete the same iteration budget, even after first reaching the full SPR target. Same game, payoff scale, repetitions, deterministic tie handling, and warm-up. CFR certifies its average with two extra best responses every check_every iterations; FP and DO certify their current output every iteration using their own oracle values. Iterations have different work; compare elapsed time and work counts as well. Subsidiary analyses use separately recorded stopping rules.
configuration.chance: Exact weighted enumeration; no sampling or training seed.
configuration.history_storage: Complete measured histories are stored in per-run gzip JSONL files: CFR every check_every iterations, FP and DO every iteration. Main JSON retains exact regular history_output_every checkpoints, first target, requested summary checkpoints, and final observation. History archival is outside solver timing.

main_protocol.first_target: First recorded certificate at or below the target: CFR checks every check_every iterations, FP and DO every iteration. A later rise does not erase this observation.
main_protocol.history_storage: Each history_file is relative to this JSON file and contains all measured observations as gzip JSONL. Main history contains exact regular history_output_every checkpoints, the first target certificate, summary_checkpoints, and the final observation; no interpolation.
main_protocol.scope: Full-budget or early-stop mode applies to main scenario/method repetitions. Subsidiary analyses have their own explicit protocols.
